item.title: Utsunomiya Gyoza: Japan's Self-Proclaimed Gyoza Capital — Guide
item.description: Utsunomiya has branded itself Japan’s gyoza (pan-fried dumpling) capital, a claim rooted in soldiers returning from northeastern China after WWII who brought dumpling-making techniques back to the city, which then developed an unusually high concentration of specialist restaurants. Gyoza Street (Gyoza Dori) near the station is lined with competing shops, each with its own recipe and style, and the city’s annual Gyoza Festival each November draws large crowds sampling dozens of variations from vendors across the region.
